svg.title: Plot 179
svg.desc: Scatter plot of lat against lon, colored by depth, sized by mag, with labels, on a globe. longitude from -180 to 180, latitude from -90 to 90. 6,397 points.

svg.style: --axis-line: #727272; --axis-halo: #ffffff; font: 400 14px "Source Sans 3", system-ui, -apple-system, sans-serif; color: rgb(37, 37, 37); fill: rgb(0, 0, 0); stroke: none; stroke-width: 1px; paint-order: normal; opacity: 1; stroke-dasharray: none; stroke-linecap: butt; stroke-linejoin: miter; position: static;

ellipse.style: font: 400 14px "Source Sans 3", system-ui, -apple-system, sans-serif; fill: none; stroke: rgb(114, 114, 114); stroke-width: 1px; paint-order: normal; color: rgb(37, 37, 37); opacity: 1; stroke-dasharray: none; stroke-linecap: butt; stroke-linejoin: miter;

svg.style: font: 400 13px "Source Sans 3", system-ui, sans-serif; fill: rgb(0, 0, 0); stroke: none; stroke-width: 1px; paint-order: normal; color: rgb(48, 52, 59); opacity: 1; stroke-dasharray: none; stroke-linecap: butt; stroke-linejoin: miter; position: static;

text.style: font: 400 10px system-ui, -apple-system, "Segoe UI", sans-serif; fill: rgb(61, 58, 54); stroke: rgba(255, 255, 255, 0.85); stroke-width: 3px; paint-order: stroke; color: rgb(48, 52, 59); opacity: 1; stroke-dasharray: none; stroke-linecap: butt; stroke-linejoin: miter;
